QUOTE: "**Deny list**: consulted only in `ServerManager::execute`. A match blocks the call even under `auto_approve` or an allow match." and "The deny list is the only permission-list entry that can actually stop a call"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the deny list is consulted in ServerManager::execute and is the only permission list that can stop a call, while the allow list only skips the prompt.
